name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.78: fridge command types, planogram counts, per-machine language, and fridge complaints. Adds command types fridge_open_door (validated cabinet, rejects B on single fridges), scale_read, scale_calibrate and scale_tare (force flag to override the machine empty-basket check) on the existing command queue. Adds capacity and expectedCount to fridge baskets for low-stock and shrinkage only (never used for charging; the settlement recompute stays weight-based). Adds a per-machine language block to config with is/en/pl codes plus labels and Polish, settable via machine update. Adds POST machines/:deviceCode/fridge/complaints referencing a settlement by orderId with reason not_taken/wrong_quantity/returned_but_charged/other, optional customer email, kioskAppVersion, and a 3-in-24h cluster alert. Cumulative over v5.77.
